items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Sid Catlett, Jack Teagarden, Earl Hines, Barney Bigard, and Louie, they were sensational... I was with him five years.

ctx.x: No, because Barney Bigard told it to me. He said at that time, you know, God there was so much pressure that was going on then, you know, between the blacks and the whites, you know, especially white women and black men. That when Duke did some picture, I don't know what it was--

items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: We had a drummer -- we had Cozy Cole at one time

ctx.x: When I met you, you were with Louie and there was a five-piece band. Who were the other people? You said a seven-piece band.
Let's see. We had a drummer -- we had Cozy Cole at one time -- No, Big Sid, Teagarden. That's two. Who was playing piano? Oh, --
Earl was when I met you.
